mentions.name: Self-hosted Album Club Service
mentions.description: This is a standalone, self-hosted service for running music album clubs. Members take turns pitching one album per week, with support for comments and emoji-based reactions. It integrates with Spotify for easy pitching and playing via links only, so users are not required to have a Spotify account. Clubs are kept fairly small and invite-only. Built in Gleam.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have started working on a standalone, self-hosted, service for an album club (music, that is).
